metadata.title: An elementary solution to the polarization problem
metadata.abstract: By distilling and combining the ideas of previous arguments, we provide a self-contained and entirely elementary proof of the strong and linear polarization problems.

analysis.workSummary: 提炼并组合既有论证，给出强极化和线性极化问题的自包含初等证明。
techniques: 既有论证的提炼与组合
analysis.breakthrough: 可能降低相关极值问题的学习门槛，提供便于复用的证明。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未明确问题的定义、精确常数及新证明的关键步骤；不能当作新的最优界。 当前为摘要级数学分析，主结果和证明尚未逐段核查；AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.priorityReason: 短篇且自包含，适合查阅证明工具，突破程度仍需正文比较。

analysisBasis.abstract: By distilling and combining the ideas of previous arguments, we provide a self-contained and entirely elementary proof of the strong and linear polarization problems.
